entries.text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
entries.source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

entries.text: Stop!
entries.source_text: Stop!

entries.text: Die, human!
entries.source_text: Die, human!

entries.text: To the death.
entries.source_text: To the death.

entries.text: You will pay for your sins!
entries.source_text: You will pay for your sins!

entries.text: I will crush you!
entries.source_text: I will crush you!

entries.text: Unity forever!
entries.source_text: Unity forever!

entries.text: For the Master!
entries.source_text: For the Master!

entries.text: You are not supposed to be armed in this area, little brother. Explain # yourself.
entries.source_text:
You are not supposed to be armed in this area, little brother. Explain
 # yourself.

entries.text: You are not supposed to be armed in this area, little sister. Explain # yourself.
entries.source_text:
You are not supposed to be armed in this area, little sister. Explain
 # yourself.

entries.text: Hngg.
entries.source_text: Hngg.

entries.text: It's okay, I work here.
entries.source_text: It's okay, I work here.

entries.text: It's okay, I have a pass.
entries.source_text: It's okay, I have a pass.

entries.text: I am armed by permission of the Lieutenant.
entries.source_text: I am armed by permission of the Lieutenant.

entries.text: What manner of treason is this?!
entries.source_text: What manner of treason is this?!

entries.text: Show me your pass, then.
entries.source_text: Show me your pass, then.

entries.text: I, uh, left it in my other robe.
entries.source_text: I, uh, left it in my other robe.

entries.text: 站住！
entries.source_text: 站住！

entries.text: 死吧，人类！
entries.source_text: 死吧，人类！

entries.text: 死去吧！
entries.source_text: 死去吧！

entries.text: 你会为你的罪过付出代价！
entries.source_text: 你会为你的罪过付出代价！

entries.text: 我要撕碎你！
entries.source_text: 我要撕碎你！

entries.text: 同一万岁！
entries.source_text: 同一万岁！

entries.text: 主教万岁！
entries.source_text: 主教万岁！

entries.text: 这里你不能带武器，小兄弟。请见谅。
entries.source_text: 这里你不能带武器，小兄弟。请见谅。

entries.text: 这里你不能带武器，小妹妹。请见谅。
entries.source_text: 这里你不能带武器，小妹妹。请见谅。

entries.text: 嗯！
entries.source_text: 嗯！

entries.text: 别那么紧张，我是在这干活的。
entries.source_text: 别那么紧张，我是在这干活的。

entries.text: 别在意，我只是路过。
entries.source_text: 别在意，我只是路过。

entries.text: 我这么做是经过中尉许可的。
entries.source_text: 我这么做是经过中尉许可的。

entries.text: 难道你想造反吗？！
entries.source_text: 难道你想造反吗？！

entries.text: 那么出示通行证！
entries.source_text: 那么出示通行证！

entries.text: 呃，我把它忘在别的长袍里了。
entries.source_text: 呃，我把它忘在别的长袍里了。

entries.text: 老老实实站在我的枪口下别动！
entries.source_text: 老老实实站在我的枪口下别动！

entries.text: It's right here, stapled to the front of my gun.
entries.source_text: It's right here, stapled to the front of my gun.

entries.text: Hurry on your task then, but be warned -- I'm watching you.
entries.source_text: Hurry on your task then, but be warned -- I'm watching you.

entries.text: Yes, little brother. What is it that you need from me?
entries.source_text: Yes, little brother. What is it that you need from me?

entries.text: Yes, little sister. What is it that you need from me?
entries.source_text: Yes, little sister. What is it that you need from me?

entries.text: Hng!
entries.source_text: Hng!

entries.text: Hmm, where's this Master guy?
entries.source_text: Hmm, where's this Master guy?

entries.text: Praise to the Unity, brother.
entries.source_text: Praise to the Unity, brother.

entries.text: I am not one to guide you on the path to Unity. Leave!
entries.source_text: I am not one to guide you on the path to Unity. Leave!

entries.text: You are obviously a heathen! Pay for your sins!
entries.source_text: You are obviously a heathen! Pay for your sins!

entries.text: Here is here. Why do you ask?
entries.source_text: Here is here. Why do you ask?

entries.text: Oh, uh, no reason.
entries.source_text: Oh, uh, no reason.

entries.text: I am going to kick his ass from here to, uh, someplace really far away!
entries.source_text: I am going to kick his ass from here to, uh, someplace really far away!

entries.text: What question? I said 'Hail to the Master, goodbye.'
entries.source_text: What question? I said 'Hail to the Master, goodbye.'

entries.text: You insult me! Die!
entries.source_text: You insult me! Die!

entries.text: Praise to the Unity.
entries.source_text: Praise to the Unity.

entries.text: You sound like you do not believe what you say. Could this be true? # Or have you left the path of righteous?
entries.source_text:
You sound like you do not believe what you say. Could this be true?
 # Or have you left the path of righteous?

entries.text: You mistake the tremor in my voice for fear when it is actually # a cold of some sort.
entries.source_text:
You mistake the tremor in my voice for fear when it is actually
 # a cold of some sort.

entries.text: I think your kind is doomed, actually. Here, let me prove it with # some help from my friends . . .
entries.source_text:
I think your kind is doomed, actually. Here, let me prove it with
 # some help from my friends . . .

entries.text: 赶紧去干活，你最好别耍花样，我会一直盯着你的。
entries.source_text: 赶紧去干活，你最好别耍花样，我会一直盯着你的。

entries.text: 啊，小兄弟，你想要什么？
entries.source_text: 啊，小兄弟，你想要什么？

entries.text: 啊，小妹妹，你想要什么？
entries.source_text: 啊，小妹妹，你想要什么？

entries.text: 嗯！
entries.source_text: 嗯！

entries.text: 那，这个叫主教的家伙在哪里？
entries.source_text: 那，这个叫主教的家伙在哪里？

entries.text: 赞美同一，兄弟！
entries.source_text: 赞美同一，兄弟！

entries.text: 我不是那个为你指点同一之道的人，离开吧！
entries.source_text: 我不是那个为你指点同一之道的人，离开吧！

entries.text: 你这个异教徒！为你的罪行付出代价吧！
entries.source_text: 你这个异教徒！为你的罪行付出代价吧！

entries.text: 这就是这，你干吗这么问？
entries.source_text: 这就是这，你干吗这么问？

entries.text: 哦，啊，没什么。
entries.source_text: 哦，啊，没什么。

entries.text: 我真想在他的屁股上来一脚，呃，但是太远了我够不到
entries.source_text: 我真想在他的屁股上来一脚，呃，但是太远了我够不到

entries.text: 什么问题？我就是去和主教打个招呼。
entries.source_text: 什么问题？我就是去和主教打个招呼。

entries.text: 你冒犯了我！死吧！
entries.source_text: 你冒犯了我！死吧！

entries.text: 赞美统一！
entries.source_text: 赞美统一！

entries.text: 你说的话连自己都不信，是不是？或者说你已经背弃了真理的道路？
entries.source_text: 你说的话连自己都不信，是不是？或者说你已经背弃了真理的道路？

entries.text: 我声音发颤是因为天气冷，不是害怕，你别搞错了。
entries.source_text: 我声音发颤是因为天气冷，不是害怕，你别搞错了。

entries.text: 你属于那一类天生应该完蛋的，我会在朋友的帮助下向你证明的……
entries.source_text: 你属于那一类天生应该完蛋的，我会在朋友的帮助下向你证明的……

entries.text: When you become one of us, you will not fear such minor things. # Begone.
entries.source_text:
When you become one of us, you will not fear such minor things.
 # Begone.

entries.text: What do you want this time? I have little time for your talk.
entries.source_text: What do you want this time? I have little time for your talk.

entries.text: Labbo!
entries.source_text: Labbo!

entries.text: I have little time for your life . . . Die!
entries.source_text: I have little time for your life . . . Die!

entries.text: Nothing, sorry.
entries.source_text: Nothing, sorry.

entries.text: Praise to the Unity, brother.
entries.source_text: Praise to the Unity, brother.

entries.text: You are obviously an intruder!
entries.source_text: You are obviously an intruder!

entries.text: Get out of my face.
entries.source_text: Get out of my face.

entries.text: I don't have time for you. Stop bothering me.
entries.source_text: I don't have time for you. Stop bothering me.

entries.text: You see a Super Mutant Sargeant.
entries.source_text: You see a Super Mutant Sargeant.

entries.text: Hey, this looks like a nuclear bomb. Why is it here?
entries.source_text: Hey, this looks like a nuclear bomb. Why is it here?

entries.text: This is our Master's weapon of last resort. If we find # an enemy we cannot defeat in battle, then we will destroy them # with this. But I doubt this will ever happen. Even our Master # does not want to unleash the dreaded power of the atom again!
entries.source_text:
This is our Master's weapon of last resort. If we find
 # an enemy we cannot defeat in battle, then we will destroy them
 # with this. But I doubt this will ever happen. Even our Master
 # does not want to unleash the dreaded power of the atom again!

entries.text: Ok, thanks.
entries.source_text: Ok, thanks.

entries.text: Is it functional?
entries.source_text: Is it functional?

entries.text: You're welcome. Now be quiet, I need to concentrate on # guarding this device.
entries.source_text:
You're welcome. Now be quiet, I need to concentrate on
 # guarding this device.

entries.text: Oh, yes, it is. We keep it in perfect working condition, # ready to be detonated at a moment's notice. The Unity will not # be defeated!
entries.source_text:
Oh, yes, it is. We keep it in perfect working condition,
 # ready to be detonated at a moment's notice. The Unity will not
 # be defeated!

entries.text: 当你成为我们的一员后，就不再会害怕这些小东西了，可怜虫。
entries.source_text: 当你成为我们的一员后，就不再会害怕这些小东西了，可怜虫。

entries.text: 你这次又想要什么？我没空搭理你。
entries.source_text: 你这次又想要什么？我没空搭理你。

entries.text: 干活去！
entries.source_text: 干活去！

entries.text: 我没工夫浪费在你的小命上了，去死吧！
entries.source_text: 我没工夫浪费在你的小命上了，去死吧！

entries.text: 没有什么，对不住了。
entries.source_text: 没有什么，对不住了。

entries.text: 赞美同一，兄弟！
entries.source_text: 赞美同一，兄弟！

entries.text: 显然，你是个入侵！
entries.source_text: 显然，你是个入侵！

entries.text: 从我眼前消失！
entries.source_text: 从我眼前消失！

entries.text: 没空搭理你！别来烦我！
entries.source_text: 没空搭理你！别来烦我！

entries.text: 一个超级变种人队长。
entries.source_text: 一个超级变种人队长。

entries.text: 嘿，这东西看起来是个核弹，怎么弄来的？
entries.source_text: 嘿，这东西看起来是个核弹，怎么弄来的？

entries.text: 这是主教用来在最终圣战中用的武器，如果碰到寻常战斗不可能战胜的对手，我们就可以使用这件神器取胜，不过你知道这种事情不可能发生的，就是主教也不想再使用毁灭性武器了。
entries.source_text: 这是主教用来在最终圣战中用的武器，如果碰到寻常战斗不可能战胜的对手，我们就可以使用这件神器取胜，不过你知道这种事情不可能发生的，就是主教也不想再使用毁灭性武器了。

entries.text: 好的，谢谢。
entries.source_text: 好的，谢谢。

entries.text: 这东西还能用吗？
entries.source_text: 这东西还能用吗？

entries.text: 不客气，不过请闭嘴吧，我要集中精力看着设备。
entries.source_text: 不客气，不过请闭嘴吧，我要集中精力看着设备。

entries.text: 哦，对，就那么回事，我们让它处于良好的运行状态，能在任何需要的时刻引爆。我们是不可战胜的！
entries.source_text: 哦，对，就那么回事，我们让它处于良好的运行状态，能在任何需要的时刻引爆。我们是不可战胜的！

entries.text: Ah, thanks.
entries.source_text: Ah, thanks.

entries.text: Aren't you worried that someone could steal some robes # and sneak in here to set it off?
entries.source_text:
Aren't you worried that someone could steal some robes
 # and sneak in here to set it off?

entries.text: No. We are here to guard it from intruders. No one could # access the device without us noticing. Besides, the nuclear arming # key required to arm the device is not here.
entries.source_text:
No. We are here to guard it from intruders. No one could
 # access the device without us noticing. Besides, the nuclear arming
 # key required to arm the device is not here.

entries.text: Oh, that makes sense. Thanks.
entries.source_text: Oh, that makes sense. Thanks.

entries.text: Well, for my sense of safety, could you tell me where the # key is located?
entries.source_text:
Well, for my sense of safety, could you tell me where the
 # key is located?

entries.text: Oh, sure, no problem. The Lieutenant keeps the key. He's # at the Military Base, so he isn't even around here. That keeps # the nuclear bomb from being set off under our beloved Master.
entries.source_text:
Oh, sure, no problem. The Lieutenant keeps the key. He's
 # at the Military Base, so he isn't even around here. That keeps
 # the nuclear bomb from being set off under our beloved Master.

entries.text: Thanks for your time.
entries.source_text: Thanks for your time.

entries.text: 【The large mutant peers at you for a moment, with bushy # eyebrows raised】 I think you are asking too many questions.
entries.source_text:
【The large mutant peers at you for a moment, with bushy
 # eyebrows raised】 I think you are asking too many questions.

entries.text: 啊，多谢。
entries.source_text: 啊，多谢。

entries.text: 你们就不担心有人潜入进来破坏设备？
entries.source_text: 你们就不担心有人潜入进来破坏设备？

entries.text: 我们在这就是预防入侵者的，没有人可以瞒过我的眼睛接近设备。还有，启动系统的密钥保存在很隐秘的地方。
entries.source_text: 我们在这就是预防入侵者的，没有人可以瞒过我的眼睛接近设备。还有，启动系统的密钥保存在很隐秘的地方。

entries.text: 哦，如我所见，谢谢了！
entries.source_text: 哦，如我所见，谢谢了！

entries.text: 哦，我看这样够安全了，介意告诉我你们把密钥放在哪里了吗？
entries.source_text: 哦，我看这样够安全了，介意告诉我你们把密钥放在哪里了吗？

entries.text: 当然没问题，中尉负责保管密钥。他在军事基地里边，他根本就不在这，这保证了核弹在我们敬爱的主教的安全控制中。
entries.source_text: 当然没问题，中尉负责保管密钥。他在军事基地里边，他根本就不在这，这保证了核弹在我们敬爱的主教的安全控制中。

entries.text: 谢谢你。
entries.source_text: 谢谢你。

entries.text: 【巨大的变种人盯了你一会后瞪大了眼睛】你的问题太多了。
entries.source_text: 【巨大的变种人盯了你一会后瞪大了眼睛】你的问题太多了。
